worked_examples.problem: A circle is divided into 8 equal sectors; 5 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
steps: Count eight equal sectors as the denominator and five shaded sectors as the numerator.

worked_examples.problem: Find a fraction equivalent to 3/5 with denominator 20.
steps: Multiply both numerator and denominator by 4 to get 12/20.
Alternatively the gaps from 1 are 1/4 and 1/6, and 1/6 is smaller.

worked_examples.problem: A ribbon is 9/10 m long and 4/10 m is used. How much remains?

misconceptions.correct: 5/6; pieces remain sixths, so the denominator stays 6.
misconceptions.remediation: Join equal-sized fraction bars; count fifths/sixths without repartitioning.

misconceptions.correct: No. 3/4 is not 6/4. Multiplying both numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number preserves value.
1/4 is larger; with one part selected, more equal partitions make each part smaller.
misconceptions.remediation: Compare same-length strips partitioned into fourths and sixths.

misconceptions.incorrect: On a 0-to-1 line with four equal intervals, a learner counts five tick marks and calls the first tick 1/5 instead of 1/4.
misconceptions.diagnostic: On a 0-to-1 line divided into five equal intervals, what fraction is the third tick after zero?
misconceptions.correct: 3/5; count intervals from zero, not the number of tick marks.
misconceptions.remediation: Mark 0 and 1, label each interval, then label endpoint positions.

misconceptions.incorrect: A learner says 4/5 > 5/6 because both are one away from their denominator and 4 < 5, so 4/5 must be larger.
misconceptions.diagnostic: Which is closer to 1: 5/6 or 7/8? Explain using gap sizes.
misconceptions.correct: 5/6 is 1/6 below one and 7/8 is 1/8 below one; since 1/8 < 1/6, 7/8 is closer.
misconceptions.remediation: Calculate exact unit-fraction gaps; compare with common-denominator fractions.

visualization_specs.title: Interactive Fraction Bar – Like-Denominator Addition
transitions: Changing n resets a,b and combined result
Combine freezes input and displays (a+b)/n with additional whole bar if a+b>n
interaction: Adjust both numerator values via pointer or keyboard
correctness: Numerator shading equals selected segment count
If a+b>n render additional unit bar; never squeeze more than n segments into a unit bar
accessibility: Reduced motion replaces animation with instant state
visualization_specs.notes: No MVE implementation in this PR. Existing MVE Agent owns visual rendering. No fraction-by-fraction multiplication.
